name: retarget-bot

from pathlib import Path
text = Path("/app/telegram_delivery.py").read_text()
old = "http://10.250.0.2:8082"
new = "http://socrat-bot.socrat-bot.svc:8080"
if old not in text and new not in text:
    raise SystemExit("telegram bot base not found")
Path("/patch/telegram_delivery.py").write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1))
